text: Test-only runtime/dependent identity prototype implemented. Final IdentityPrototypeSuite: 10 passed on JVM and 10 on Scala.js; provider/lifecycle consumer adds 8 per platform. Laws cover full declared metadata, independent source/representation identity, duplicate occurrences and nested restrictions, scalar/multiresponse targets, existing response/locus bridges, heterogeneous local Tables without Any/casts, bounded inspection with poison zero-read and explicit-read positive control, and external compile rejection. Type review tightened metadata and occurrence limits. See modules/mvpa-foundation-spike/README.md and the foundation admission/evidence records. Ready for independent M0.07 review but not closed: M0.02 admission remains blocked. Prototype is deliberately 64-coordinate/test-only, not frozen production signatures; M1 migrates laws then deletes temporary shapes.
